evidencepack/idp-posture@v1./user_security/users_present: Checks whether any user in Microsoft Graph's users list has accountEnabled true and userType Member.
evidencepack/idp-posture@v1./user_security/user_count: Counts the users with accountEnabled true and userType Member.
evidencepack/idp-posture@v1./user_security/mfa_coverage_pct: Divides the enabled member users that the userRegistrationDetails report lists with isMfaRegistered true by all enabled member users it lists, rounded down.
evidencepack/idp-posture@v1./user_security/mfa_phishing_resistant_pc: Divides the enabled member users the userRegistrationDetails report lists with a FIDO2 key, passkey, Windows Hello for Business or certificate registered by all enabled member users it lists, rounded down.
evidencepack/idp-posture@v1./user_security/inactive_pct: Divides the enabled users, guests included, whose signInActivity has no lastSuccessfulSignInDateTime in the last 90 days by all enabled users, rounded up.
evidencepack/idp-posture@v1./app_security/apps_present: Checks whether the tenant has any service principal of type Application whose accountEnabled is not false.
evidencepack/idp-posture@v1./app_security/app_count: Counts the service principals of type Application whose accountEnabled is not false.
evidencepack/idp-posture@v1./app_security/sso_app_count: Counts the enabled Application service principals whose preferredSingleSignOnMode is saml or oidc.
evidencepack/idp-posture@v1./app_security/sso_coverage_pct: Divides the enabled Application service principals whose preferredSingleSignOnMode is saml or oidc by all of them, rounded down.
evidencepack/idp-posture@v1./app_security/provisioning_enabled_pct: Written as null when the tenant has no enabled Application service principals. Provisioning settings are not read.
evidencepack/idp-posture@v1./app_security/deprovisioning_enabled_pct: Written as null when the tenant has no enabled Application service principals. Provisioning settings are not read.
evidencepack/idp-posture@v1./privileged_access/privileged_users_pres: Checks whether any enabled user has a directory role assignment to one of 11 privileged role templates.
evidencepack/idp-posture@v1./privileged_access/privileged_users_coun: Counts the distinct enabled users with a directory role assignment to one of 11 privileged role templates. It is left out when one of those roles is assigned to a group, since group members are not read.
evidencepack/idp-posture@v1./privileged_access/super_admin_count: Counts the distinct enabled users with a directory role assignment to the Global Administrator role template. It is left out when the role is assigned to a group, since group members are not read.
evidencepack/idp-posture@v1./privileged_access/privileged_mfa_user_c: Counts the privileged users the userRegistrationDetails report shows with isMfaRegistered true.
evidencepack/idp-posture@v1./privileged_access/privileged_phishing_r: Counts the privileged users whose registered methods in the userRegistrationDetails report include a FIDO2 key, passkey, Windows Hello for Business or certificate.
evidencepack/idp-posture@v1./privileged_access/privileged_mfa_covera: Divides the privileged users the userRegistrationDetails report shows with isMfaRegistered true by all privileged users, rounded down.
evidencepack/idp-posture@v1./privileged_access/privileged_phishing_r: Divides the privileged users with a phishing-resistant method registered in the userRegistrationDetails report by all privileged users, rounded down.
evidencepack/idp-posture@v1./lifecycle/accounts_present: Checks whether Microsoft Graph's users list returns any user.
evidencepack/idp-posture@v1./lifecycle/account_count: Counts every user that Microsoft Graph's users list returns. Deleted users are not in the list.
evidencepack/idp-posture@v1./lifecycle/suspended_account_count: Counts the users with accountEnabled false.
evidencepack/idp-posture@v1./lifecycle/suspended_pct: Divides the users with accountEnabled false by all users, rounded up.
evidencepack/idp-posture@v1./lifecycle/archived_pct: Written as null when the directory has no users. Deleted users are not read.
evidencepack/idp-posture@v1./policy/mfa_required: Checks for an enabled Conditional Access policy whose included users are All and whose grant requires MFA. A grant requires MFA through the mfa control or an authentication strength whose requirementsSatisfied is mfa. With the OR operator, every control in the grant must require MFA. A policy with a risk level, location, device platform, device filter or authentication flow condition applies only to some sign-ins and does not count. A policy for a user action, such as registering security information, does not count either.
evidencepack/idp-posture@v1./policy/mfa_required_user_count: Counts the enabled member users that an enabled Conditional Access policy requiring MFA includes, by user ID or as All less its excluded users. A policy counts only when it applies to every sign-in, as mfa_required describes. When no policy is enabled, it counts every enabled member user when security defaults are on and none when they are off. It is left out when an MFA policy includes or excludes a group or a role and the other policies leave members uncovered.
evidencepack/idp-posture@v1./policy/mfa_required_coverage_pct: Divides mfa_required_user_count by all enabled member users, rounded down.
evidencepack/idp-posture@v1./policy/legacy_auth_blocked: Checks for an enabled Conditional Access policy with a block grant whose included users and apps are All. It must exclude no app. Its client app types must be all, or include both exchangeActiveSync and other. It must have no risk level, location, device platform, device filter or authentication flow condition.

evidencepack/cloud-posture@v1./accounts/*/storage/storage_resources_pr: Checks whether the subscription has any storage account.
evidencepack/cloud-posture@v1./accounts/*/storage/storage_resource_cou: Counts the storage accounts in the subscription.
evidencepack/cloud-posture@v1./accounts/*/storage/encrypted_storage_re: Counts the storage accounts whose encryption key source is Microsoft.Keyvault, which means a customer-managed key.
evidencepack/cloud-posture@v1./accounts/*/storage/public_access_blocke: Counts the storage accounts with allowBlobPublicAccess false. An account without allowBlobPublicAccess counts as allowing anonymous access.
evidencepack/cloud-posture@v1./accounts/*/storage/encryption_pct: Divides the storage accounts whose encryption key source is Microsoft.Keyvault by all storage accounts, rounded down.
evidencepack/cloud-posture@v1./accounts/*/storage/public_access_blocke: Divides the storage accounts with allowBlobPublicAccess false by all storage accounts, rounded down. An account without allowBlobPublicAccess counts as allowing anonymous access.
evidencepack/cloud-posture@v1./accounts/*/logging/audit_log_enabled: Checks for a subscription diagnostic setting with a destination that enables the Administrative category or the allLogs category group.
evidencepack/cloud-posture@v1./accounts/*/logging/audit_log_all_region: Takes the value of audit_log_enabled, since the Activity Log covers every region.
evidencepack/cloud-posture@v1./accounts/*/backup/retention_days_min: Takes the shortest positive retention duration in the backup policies that the protected items of the subscription's Recovery Services vaults use. A month counts as 30 days and a year as 365. It is null when no policy in use sets a retention period, as when the subscription has no vault.
evidencepack/cloud-posture@v1./accounts/*/network/security_groups_pres: Checks whether the subscription has any network security group.
evidencepack/cloud-posture@v1./accounts/*/network/security_group_count: Counts the network security groups in the subscription.
evidencepack/cloud-posture@v1./accounts/*/network/ssh_open_security_gr: Counts the network security groups with an inbound Allow rule for TCP port 22 from *, Any, Internet, 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0.
evidencepack/cloud-posture@v1./accounts/*/network/rdp_open_security_gr: Counts the network security groups with an inbound Allow rule for TCP port 3389 from *, Any, Internet, 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0.
evidencepack/cloud-posture@v1./accounts/*/network/ssh_open_to_world_pc: Divides ssh_open_security_group_count by all network security groups, rounded up.
evidencepack/cloud-posture@v1./accounts/*/network/rdp_open_to_world_pc: Divides rdp_open_security_group_count by all network security groups, rounded up.
evidencepack/cloud-posture@v1./accounts/*/iam/root_mfa_enabled: Checks whether every enabled user that roleManagement/directory/roleAssignments gives the Global Administrator role is listed in the userRegistrationDetails report with isMfaRegistered true. It is the tenant's value, written in each subscription.
evidencepack/cloud-posture@v1./accounts/*/iam/root_access_protected: Checks whether every enabled user that roleManagement/directory/roleAssignments gives the Global Administrator role is listed in the userRegistrationDetails report with isMfaRegistered true. It is the tenant's value, written in each subscription.

evidencepack/access-posture@v1./sign_in/sso_configured: Written as true. People sign in to Azure only through Microsoft Entra ID.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./sign_in/sso_required: Written as true. Azure has no sign-in of its own, so everyone signs in through Microsoft Entra ID.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/members_present: Checks whether any enabled user in Microsoft Graph's users list has an Azure role assignment on the subscription or a scope above it. Assignments on resource groups and resources are not read.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/member_count: Counts the distinct enabled users in Microsoft Graph's users list with an Azure role assignment on the subscription or a scope above it. The totals count each user once across subscriptions.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/external_members_present: Checks whether any member has userType Guest in Microsoft Graph's users list.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/external_member_count: Counts the members with userType Guest in Microsoft Graph's users list.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/sso_member_count: Counts every member, since everyone signs in to Azure through Microsoft Entra ID.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/sso_coverage_pct: Written as 100 when there are members, since everyone signs in to Azure through Microsoft Entra ID.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/local_members_present: Written as false. No one can sign in to Azure without Microsoft Entra ID.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/local_member_count: Written as 0. No one can sign in to Azure without Microsoft Entra ID.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/local_mfa_member_count: Written as 0. No one can sign in to Azure without Microsoft Entra ID.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/local_mfa_coverage_pct: Written as null, since no member can sign in to Azure without Microsoft Entra ID. MFA for Entra ID sign-ins is in idp-posture.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/inactive_member_count: Counts the members whose signInActivity in Microsoft Graph has no lastSuccessfulSignInDateTime in the last 90 days. A member missing from the sign-in activity list counts as inactive.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./members/inactive_pct: Divides the members whose signInActivity has no lastSuccessfulSignInDateTime in the last 90 days by all members, rounded up.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./admins/admins_present: Checks whether any member has an Owner or User Access Administrator role assignment on the subscription or a scope above it.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./admins/admin_count: Counts the members with an Owner or User Access Administrator role assignment on the subscription or a scope above it.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./admins/admin_share_pct: Divides admin_count by member_count, rounded up.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./admins/local_admins_present: Written as false. No one can sign in to Azure without Microsoft Entra ID.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./admins/local_admin_count: Written as 0. No one can sign in to Azure without Microsoft Entra ID.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./admins/local_mfa_admin_count: Written as 0. No one can sign in to Azure without Microsoft Entra ID.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./admins/local_admin_mfa_coverage_pct: Written as null, since no admin can sign in to Azure without Microsoft Entra ID. MFA for Entra ID sign-ins is in idp-posture.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/credentials_present: Checks whether any service principal has an Azure role assignment on the subscription or a scope above it.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/credential_count: Counts the distinct service principals with an Azure role assignment on the subscription or a scope above it. The totals count each one once across subscriptions.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/never_expiring_credential_c: Counts the service principals with an active client secret or certificate that has no endDateTime or ends more than 50 years after the run. Each one's own credentials and those of the application with its appId are checked, and a managed identity has none.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/never_expiring_pct: Divides never_expiring_credential_count by credential_count, rounded up.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/write_access_credential_cou: Counts the service principals with a role other than Reader, Security Reader, Monitoring Reader, Billing Reader, Cost Management Reader or Log Analytics Reader. A custom role counts as write access. A service principal that is disabled in Microsoft Entra ID cannot get a token and does not count.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/write_access_pct: Divides write_access_credential_count by credential_count, rounded up.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/unused_credential_count: Written as 0 when no service principal has a role assignment. Otherwise it is left out, since service principal sign-ins are reported only in Microsoft Graph's beta API.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/unused_pct: Written as null when no service principal has a role assignment. Otherwise it is left out, since service principal sign-ins are reported only in Microsoft Graph's beta API.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/unrestricted_credential_cou: Written as 0 when every service principal holds only the read-only roles listed for write_access_credential_count, since those roles are narrower than full access. Otherwise it is left out, since custom role definitions and Conditional Access location conditions are not read.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/unrestricted_pct: Written as 0 when every service principal holds only the read-only roles listed for write_access_credential_count, and null when no service principal has a role assignment. Otherwise it is left out, since custom role definitions and Conditional Access location conditions are not read.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/rotation_overdue_credential: Counts the service principals with an active client secret or certificate whose startDateTime is more than 90 days before the run. Each one's own credentials and those of the application with its appId are checked, and a managed identity has none.
evidencepack/access-posture@v1./credentials/rotation_overdue_pct: Divides rotation_overdue_credential_count by credential_count, rounded up.
